decisions.reason: An evening psychiatric day-patient program builds directly on the firm's specialist psychiatric and psychosomatic expertise, so the firm can interpret early utilization data and refine the offer with its multidisciplinary teams.

The custom furniture carpentry draws on the firm's practical therapy and production know-how from its sheltered workshops, though it lies further from its core care knowledge and faces market demand risk.
Outpatient sociotherapy is a close extension of the firm's mental health and outpatient support competences, uses reimbursable statutory benefits, and fits its expansion strategy.
Senior living counseling rests on the firm's core eldercare knowledge, is prominently featured on the home page, and feeds clients into its residential and outpatient services.

A retail shop selling sheltered-workshop goods uses existing production capabilities and supports inclusion goals, but retail is a less familiar domain with only modest visibility, which raises some risk of discontinuation.
